newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Real Software price range 1,300-1,500 Bfr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Real Software price range 1,300-1,500 Bfr.

text.p: The price range for 420,000 shares in Belgian information technology (IT) services firm Real Software, to be listed on the Brussels bourse early next month, was set at 1,300 to 1,500 francs, the company said on Wednesday.
It said in the prospectus on the IPO subscriptions would run from May 22 to June 6 but could be closed early at any time.
Real Software, currently management-owned, is offering 38 percent of its capital to the public in a deal managed by KB Securities and co-lead by Generale Bank and Bank Degroof.
The price-fixing will be on June 6 at the latest.
The prospectus said an additional 42,000 shares could be offered within the framework of an "option on oversubscription".
The software development and implementation company has 400 employees, annual turnover of some 1.2 billion francs, of which one third is realised abroad, and net profit of 102 million francs.
KB Securities analyst Johan Pede said in a report on Real Software that the IPO price range implied a substantial discount compared with the theoretical value.
He expected Real Software's net turnover to grow 16.5 percent in 1997, 20.9 percent in 1998 and 18.8 percent in 1999.
The EPS growth rate was seen at 20.8 percent in 1997, 23.0 percent in 1998 and 20.6 percent in 1999.

Real Software is the second Belgian IT firm to come to the market in the first half of 1997. Systemat NV, founded in 1984, offers hardware, configuration, assembly, installation, training and support services.
